basics.name: Jose Roberto Blanco Pulido
basics.label: Junior Software Developer | Web, Mobile and Desktop | JavaScript, Python, C#
basics.summary: Recent Virtual Environments and Digital Business engineering graduate with 2+ years of experience building web, mobile and desktop software. I work with JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C# and Kotlin, integrate services through REST APIs, and build tools and automations that remove repetitive work. I was lead developer of an Android app delivered end to end and built a web analytics system connected through a REST API. I adapt quickly to new languages, teams and domains, and I am looking for a junior developer position at an IT company.
